rationale: The test constructs and validates Entity objects using the `name` field in v1 assertions, but this field was removed from the schema. The test must be updated to remove all references to the `name` field while preserving the `entity_id`, service-order checks, and negative validation logic. Empty string coverage is preserved by moving sample text into a retained string field (if needed), though here it’s unnecessary since no string fields remain. All assertions are kept strict for retained fields (`entity_id`).
assumptions: The `Entity` class in the testbed is generated and matches the proto schema exactly.
No other fields or logic depend on `name` beyond what’s shown here.
The host will regenerate bindings after this change.
